title: NC-PLUS-TICKFAIL-criticality-2026-11-13T12: Auto-create criticality_samples table on tick so tick step never fails on missing schema
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the backlog item PLUS-TICKFAIL-criticality-2026-11-13T12 was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer
**Done check:** cmd:python3 scripts/needs_code_bridge.py --probe PLUS-TICKFAIL-criticality-2026-11-13T12
**Status:** closed

Auto-create criticality_samples table on tick so tick step never fails on missing schema

Backlog done check: Tick completes step criticality with criticality_samples table present after schema bootstrap runs

Triage: Schema bootstrap for criticality_samples requires a code change to the tick worker; the doer can only touch the backlog DB, not modify code. | first step: Open a change item to add DDL (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS criticality_samples) to the tick step's schema bootstrap path.

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 26.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
